description: BrowseMCP lets AI coding agents control the user's own Chrome-family browser through a hosted MCP server and a browser extension. The service confines agent activity to a dedicated tab group and can use the user's existing browser sessions.
summary: BrowseMCP exposes one hosted MCP server at https://api.browsemcp.online/mcp over streamable HTTP, authenticated with a BrowseMCP API key via Bearer header or `?key=` query parameter.
